question: Simplify (3x - 2y) (3x + 2y) (9x² + 4y²).
solution:
**Given:**

(3x - 2y) (3x + 2y) (9x2 + 4y2)

**Concept used:**

a² - b² = (a + b)(a - b)

**Calculation:**

(3x - 2y) (3x + 2y) (9x2 + 4y2)

⇒ {(3x)² - (2y)²} (9x2 + 4y2)

⇒ {9x2 - 4y2} (9x2 + 4y2)

⇒ 81x4 - 16y4

**∴ The required answer is 81x4 - 16y4**.
